findings.title: Materials' 54-point lens gap signals earnings collapse bet
findings.body: Materials trades at 17.09x forward versus 37.46x trailing, a 54 percent compression that ranks its trailing multiple at the 90th percentile. Analysts are underwriting 119 percent earnings growth, an extraordinary bet that reported earnings are about to be left in the dust.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' percentile gap hides a valuation crash
findings.body: Consumer Staples' forward multiple sits at the 15th percentile while its trailing multiple ranks at the 79th, a 63-point gap. The 30 percent compression implies analysts expect a 44 percent earnings surge, yet the forward percentile has fallen 20 points in a month — the market is pricing in a recovery that keeps getting pushed out.

findings.title: Communication Services' forward multiple is historically cheap
findings.body: Communication Services trades at 13.65x forward, the 1st percentile of its five-year range, while its trailing multiple sits at the 27th percentile. The 36 percent compression and 55 percent implied growth suggest the market is pricing in a dramatic earnings rebound from a deeply depressed base.
